### What's Changed

- feat(stack): import layer stacks from EMX process files [#343](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim/pull/343)

- fix(palace): read eigenmode fields and exact-zero S parameters [#315](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim/pull/315)

- fix(palace): export valid transient solver settings [#308](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim/pull/308)
- fix(palace): validate problem targets and fallback configs [#307](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim/pull/307)
- fix(palace): align field saves with frequency samples [#305](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim/pull/305)

#### Refactoring

- refactor(palace): group solver settings under sim.solver [#331](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim/pull/331)

#### Maintenance

- ci: limit docs notebook execution to 30 minutes [#333](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim/pull/333)

#### Documentation

- docs(palace): physical RLGC in the CPW de-embedding notebook (joint fit with impedance anchors) [#342](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim/pull/342)
